<USER_REQUEST>
You are a participant in a short perception study. Answer exactly as asked.

Quick task, first impressions please.
Each item below shows symbols in a sequence; the last one listed is where the sequence has got to.
For each item, answer with one of:
  - "none": true, if nothing seems to come next
  - "continue": the symbols that come after the last one, in order, as many as come naturally (up to 24)
Any symbol may come next, whether it is shown or not; it may have no name.
Go by first impressions, and judge each item on its own rather than building a scheme across items.
"none" is expected often and is fully valuable.

Items:
{"id": 0, "s": ["④", "⑤"]}
{"id": 1, "s": ["🃥", "🃦", "🃧", "🃨", "🃩", "🃪", "🃫", "🃬"]}
{"id": 2, "s": ["㉙", "㉚", "㉛", "㉜"]}
{"id": 3, "s": ["㏨", "㏩"]}
{"id": 4, "s": ["㊼", "㊽"]}

Reply with JSON only, no prose: {"answers": [ ... ]}, one entry per item, each {"id": <id>, "continue": [...]} or {"id": <id>, "none": true}.
</USER_REQUEST>

thinking: The first sequence represents circled numbers, progressing sequentially; the next logical element is the circled number 6. The second sequence contains Unicode playing card symbols, indicating a hand of clubs, starting from the 5 of clubs and proceeding sequentially.
